skunk.answersHtml:
What is it?Mammal
Carnivore?Omnivore

Domesticated?No
Awake when?Night

Skunks are crepuscular: most active at dusk and dawn.

Not true hibernators, but they den up through winter, staying mostly inactive and feeding rarely.

Kept as a pet?Sometimes

Some people keep skunks as pets, usually with the scent glands removed.

Do people eat it?No

bat.answersHtml:
What is it?Mammal
Carnivore?Insects only

Many bats eat insects, but most of the rest eat fruit or nectar, and vampire bats feed on blood.

Dangerous?Can be

Bats carry diseases such as rabies, which makes handling them risky.

Domesticated?No
Awake when?Night
Hibernates?Yes

Bats in temperate regions hibernate or go into torpor; tropical bats don’t.

Kept as a pet?No
Do people eat it?In places

Bats are eaten in parts of Asia and Africa and on some Pacific and Caribbean islands.
